data.title: Employers Turn to 401(k)-Style Auto-Enrollment to Lift HSA Participation
data.description: According to CNBC, employers are increasingly using 401(k)-style automatic enrollment to boost worker participation in health savings accounts, with nearly 46% of employers automatically opting workers into an HSA in 2025 if they enrolled in a high-deductible health plan, up from 32% in 2019. The Plan Sponsor Council of America said about 64% of employers auto-enrolled workers into a 401(k) plan in 2025, while HSA Bank's Ann Brisk said relying on employees to open accounts on their own makes participation harder. The report also said about 77% of employers made an HSA contribution in 2025, and roughly 10% of those that contribute matched employee deposits, with another 7.5% considering it. High-deductible plans carry deductibles of at least $1,700 for individuals and $3,400 for families in 2026, and total worker and employer HSA contributions for self-only coverage cannot exceed $4,400, while the family limit is $8,750.

data.title: Iran's Revolutionary Guard Says It Dismantled Terror Cell in Southeast Province, Killing Two
data.description: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said on September 5 local time that it dismantled a terror group in Sistan and Baluchestan province in southeastern Iran and killed two militants. According to Jiemian News, the Guard said the group was linked to the United States and Israel and had planned attacks in the province if the United States launched a war, but the plot was stopped before any attack was carried out. The United States and Israel had not responded.

data.title: GM And Ford Expand Into Defense And Energy Storage Markets
data.description:
According to CNBC, General Motors and Ford Motor are expanding into U.S. military contracting and the energy storage system market as both automakers look for new growth areas beyond electric vehicles. GM said it expects 2026 defense revenue to rise to almost $700 million and is targeting positive earnings before interest and tax this year, while Ford said in December it plans to spend $2 billion to launch an energy business and convert a Kentucky battery factory to make storage units by late 2027.

GM recently won a U.S. Army contract to build infantry squad vehicles that it said could exceed $1 billion depending on congressional appropriations. Ford also announced a tie-up with General Dynamics Land Systems and engineering firm Ricardo to compete for a next-generation vehicle for the United Kingdom's Ministry of Defence. In energy storage, Global Market Insights estimates the global ESS market will grow from $668.7 billion in 2024 to $5.12 trillion by 2034. GM is developing next-generation sodium-ion batteries with Peak Energy and has a partnership with Redwood Materials, while Ford CEO Jim Farley said the company is in the "third inning" of selling out 20 gigawatt hours of ESS production capacity after a framework agreement with EDF Power Solutions North America.

data.title: OpenAI Expands Policy Team With Three State-Level Hires
data.description:
OpenAI is expanding its global affairs team with three new hires focused on state-level policy. According to Sina Finance, the company said it brought in policy specialists with Republican and Democratic backgrounds and industry experience as bipartisan scrutiny of artificial intelligence intensifies across the United States.

Jessica Schumer, a former chief of staff to the Obama administration's Council of Economic Advisers, will handle policy and partnerships in the U.S. Northeast. Schumer is the daughter of Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer and previously led Amazon's public policy work in New York.

Caulder Harvill-Childs, who previously handled public policy for Meta, will lead state policy and partnerships in the U.S. Southeast. Harvill-Childs is a veteran Republican policy specialist who previously worked for Georgia House Speaker Jon Burns.

Thomas McClellan will lead OpenAI's state cybersecurity defense policy. He has more than 20 years of experience in cybersecurity and public policy and previously worked at Palo Alto Networks, Symantec, FireEye, and the National Governors Association.

data.title: British Investor Recovers Bitcoin Lost After Intersango Shutdown
data.description:
A British investor who bought Bitcoin in 2011 through the Britcoin exchange, later renamed Intersango, has regained access to part of his lost holdings after more than a decade. According to ChainCatcher, he had invested about 1,500 pounds, or roughly $2,000, and lost wallet access after the exchange stopped trading at the end of 2012 and went offline in early 2014.

CEL Solicitors said its sister company’s crypto tracing software identified a wallet believed to belong to an Intersango user and holding more than 5,500 BTC. The investor recovered about $45,000 worth of Bitcoin, which is now valued at about $4.5 million. The firm said other former Intersango users may also be able to recover funds if they can prove ownership.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | Iran, Ukraine Conflicts Tighten Global Energy Markets
data.description:
Renewed US-Iran fighting and uncertainty over shipping through the Strait of Hormuz are pressuring global energy markets, while the threat of mines is still deterring some traffic, according to Bloomberg.

Ukraine’s attacks on Russian refineries are also worsening tight diesel supplies, and Bloomberg News Oil Products Reporter Will Kubzansky described the situation as a distillates crisis heading into peak demand season.

data.title: Huaxing Securities Names Zhao Kai CEO, Chen Jiaxin Deputy CEO
data.description:
Huaxing Securities, a unit of Huaxing Capital, appointed former deputy general manager Zhao Kai as chief executive officer and Chen Jiaxin as deputy general manager on September 2, according to Jiemian News. The move completes a major management reshuffle at the brokerage over the past 18 months.

Zhao, who joined Huaxing Securities in 2020 and previously worked at CITIC Securities and Zhongde Securities, has held roles including head of investment banking, head of sponsorship business and deputy general manager. Huaxing Capital chair Xu Yanqing said the appointments are intended to strengthen links between primary and secondary markets and deepen the firm’s securities strategy.

Huaxing Securities has been reorganizing its leadership while trying to improve performance. The brokerage posted revenue of 287 million yuan in 2025, up 18.2%, but still recorded a net loss of 46 million yuan. In the first half of 2026, total revenue and net investment income rose 40.3% year on year to about 181 million yuan, and operating profit turned positive at about 8.4 million yuan after four straight years of losses.

Retail brokerage was the main growth driver, with first-half revenue of about 78 million yuan, up 36%. As of the end of the reporting period, its Duoduojin app had about 640,000 registered users, up 12% from the end of 2025, while customer assets rose 23%.

The notice says users should conduct their own research before using Binance Wallet and states that the information provided is not financial advice. It is limited to a general responsibility and risk notice for users of the wallet and related dApp access.

data.title: Crypto News: August Jobs Smash Expectations at 162,000 — Wall Street Falls, September Hike Odds Jump to 58%, CPI on September 11 Decides the Rest
data.description: The US added 162,000 jobs in August — nearly triple the 53,000 consensus — while July was revised from -23,000 to +23,000, erasing the two-consecutive-negative-readings precedent that was Bitcoin's last defense against a September hike. Wall Street closed lower: S&P 500 -0.38%, Dow -0.51%, with Apple -2.51% and Tesla -5.92% leading declines. September hike odds jumped from 49% to 58%. The 2-year Treasury yield hit its highest since January 2025. Semiconductors rallied — Philadelphia Semi Index +3%, SanDisk +11%, SK Hynix +8%. Trump called for rate cuts anyway. CPI on September 11 and the FOMC on September 16 are the only remaining variables.Bitcoin OG Holders Increase Activity as 90-Day Spent UTXO Average Reaches 1,500 BTCActivity among Bitcoin holders with 5+ year holding periods has doubled since May, with the 90-day moving average of their spent UTXOs rising to 1,500 BTC. Darkfost noted the transfers are not necessarily sales — post-Coldcard exploit, a significant portion likely reflects moves to safer storage rather than distribution. Long-term holder movement at this scale is worth monitoring: when OG holders move coins to exchanges rather than new cold storage, it signals distribution; when they move within self-custody infrastructure, it signals conviction maintenance. The distinction determines whether this is a structural bullish signal or an early warning of supply coming to market.Countries Accelerate Domestic Gold Reserve Storage PlansThe World Gold Council's 2026 survey found 19% of central banks increased the share of gold held domestically or diversified custody locations over the past 12 months — up from 7% the year before. Countries have been repatriating gold reserves from New York and London vaults since 2013, but the pace has accelerated sharply. The trend is a direct expression of the sovereign risk thesis that has driven gold above $4,600 and Bitcoin's correlation with gold to a six-year high: institutions are diversifying away from concentrated custody in the Western financial system. Each percentage point increase in domestic gold storage is a data point in the same thesis that supports Bitcoin as a non-sovereign store of value. US Adds 162,000 Jobs in August, Nearly Triple Expectations, as July Revised to a GainAugust nonfarm payrolls came in at 162,000 — nearly triple the 53,000 consensus — while July was revised from -23,000 to +23,000, erasing the two-consecutive-negative-readings precedent that was Bitcoin's last defense against a September hike. June and July revised up a combined 55,000. Food services and local government education added 101,000 combined, largely offsetting July's weakness. Warsh's Jackson Hole framing — labor "consistent with full employment" — no longer needs defending. The hawkish case rested entirely on inflation; labor is now additive. Information employment falling 23,000 is the one detail worth tracking: an AI-adjacent sector contracting while everything else expands is the first category-level appearance of the automation displacement thesis. Janus Henderson's Bradford Smith: "the Fed has formed a clear inclination to raise rates if subsequent data fails to show further progress on cooling inflation."U.S. President Donald Trump Calls for Fed Rate Cuts After August Jobs ReportTrump posted on social media calling for immediate Fed rate cuts after the 162,000 print — arguing the US credit situation is stronger and should have "the lowest interest rates in the world." The unemployment rate held at 4.1%. Trump's call arrives as the Fed's September decision tilts sharply toward a hike on the same data he's using to argue the opposite. Warsh's "committed to a discipline, not a decision" framework was explicitly designed to deflect this kind of political pressure — the conflict between presidential preference and data-driven independence is now live in real time with the FOMC nine days away.Wall Street Falls as Strong Jobs Data Lifts Treasury Yields, Rate-Hike BetsThe S&P 500 fell 0.38%, Nasdaq -0.29%, Dow -0.51% as the 2-year Treasury yield hit its highest since January 2025 following the payrolls beat. Among the Magnificent Seven, Apple -2.51%, Tesla -5.92%, Microsoft -2.04%, Alphabet -1.05% — while Meta +1% and Nvidia +0.84% held up. Semiconductors bucked the trend: Philadelphia Semi Index +3%, SanDisk +11%, SK Hynix +8%, Marvell +7%. September hike odds jumped from 49.4% to 58% per CME FedWatch. For the week, the Dow fell 0.3%, S&P +0.1%, Nasdaq +0.4%. Fed Governor Waller's Thursday lean-toward-hold comment had lifted markets before Friday's data reversed it. The September 11 CPI print is now the final variable — Warsh's hawkish signal at Jackson Hole plus a strong labor market means any failure to show inflation progress likely seals a hike.

data.title: ARK Invest's Lorenzo Valente Says LayerZero Could Soon Reach Nine-Figure ARR
data.description:
ARK Invest digital asset research director Lorenzo Valente said on X that messaging and interoperability protocols have become key infrastructure as L1s, application chains, and rollup-centric roadmaps have emerged. According to ChainCatcher, he said demand for universal interoperability will grow exponentially as more assets move onchain.

Valente added that cross-chain interoperability protocol LayerZero's interoperability business could soon grow to a nine-figure annual recurring revenue run rate, and said the team has more developments ahead.

data.title: MicroStrategy Drops $250 Bitcoin Jordans In Online Store
data.description: MicroStrategy has added $250 Bitcoin Jordans to its online store, branding the Nike Air Jordans as a custom build rather than an official Nike collaboration. The listing sits alongside 53 products, but checkout accepts only cards and wallets such as Apple Pay, not Bitcoin, according to BeInCrypto, even though the merch is tied to Michael Saylor’s Bitcoin pitch. Nike stock has fallen 48.63% over the past year, while MSTR rose 45% in a month.
